# E0603: the lineage path holds lineages in several CUE packages

A directory given with -l holds more than one CUE package, and more than
one of them holds a lineage. thema cannot choose; name one file, or move the
lineages apart.

## Example

`two/a.cue`:

```cue
package a

import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"

lin: thema.Lineage & {
	name: "a"
	schemas: {
		"0": {
			"0": {
				schema: {
					a: string
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`two/b.cue`:

```cue
package b

import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"

lin: thema.Lineage & {
	name: "b"
	schemas: {
		"0": {
			"0": {
				schema: {
					a: string
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"a": "Argo"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0603]: packages a and b at the lineage path both hold a lineage
  |
  = help: name one package's file with -l, or move the lineages apart
```
